Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

- Command to switch low power mode

| Head  |Len   |Cmd  |Data |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes)   |0xb2|data   |xx   |0x02   |
Data: data[0], where:
- 1: Turn on the low power mode
- 0: Turn off the low power mode
